the main contributions of this paper are: (1) A new framework for procedural textures that allows a scene designer to specify the behavior and appearance of graftals in a scene in a text file; (2) A new approach to the multiresolution rendering of procedural textures that allows for continuous changes in graftal properties; (3) The use of tufts for managing multiresolution behavior; and (4) The implementation of an interactive tool that allows a scene artist to specify graftal properties.
